scope: Method analysis and bounded local diagnostics; no optimiser changes or new main comparison campaign.

budget_probe_protocol.instrumentation: Wrapped evaluate._peaks and thermal.die_peak_sensitivity to count real calls and thermal_key values. Unmodified topology_slp executed.

budget_finding.mechanism: A whole steps+1 chain runs even when less budget remains; returned points are truncated after all solves occurred.
budget_finding.consequence: Reported solve budget is insufficient evidence of equal actual thermal work; late evaluated states can be discarded.
budget_finding.remedy: Reserve per-chain budget before launch and pass a bounded step count; count actual solves, repeat factorisations and adjoint RHS separately.

layout_protocol: One saved nominal winner per Case3/5/9/10 from workload-search-v1.json; 1000 mutate attempts per case with seed 2026111501, gap 0. Jensen mean-pin lower bound evaluated at the same layout. Not a comparison of new algorithms or a certified global optimality gap.

data.scope: Synthetic single-die fixed package, off-centre; not a material-calibration experiment.

boundary_gradient_probe.interpretation: Inconclusive: central differences change sign between step sizes and are small. Does not establish a stable missing boundary gradient or motivate a new calibration campaign.

recommendations.change: Repair actual SLP budget accounting; record relation MILP/annealing/gradient/forward costs and solver status/bounds.
Add min linearised peak subject to exact pin length <= the frozen evaluation cap; keep min length at a frozen thermal cap as the reverse mode.
recommendations.evidence: topology_slp currently selects adaptive thermal quantiles and does not use the passed length_caps_m in SLP chains.

recommendations.change: Use active thermal constraints/duals to select a small die group for relation and rotation changes, legalise with the exact LP, and feed accepted results back into SLP.
recommendations.evidence: Current relation_space initialises with length-only moves; SLP topology changes use ordinary legal mutations. Single-layout legality rates 28.9-55.9% are descriptive only.

recommendations.change: Adaptively split net clusters with high mean-pin approximation error; warm-start the MIP, retain a small set of different relation/rotation solutions, and refine by exact length.
recommendations.evidence: Same-layout lower-bound gap is 29.8% in Case3, 1.0-2.6% in the other three probes. Not evidence of a 29.8% optimisation loss.

recommendations.change: Use model-agreement-aware trust radii and compute adjoints only for active constraints and accepted candidates, reusing a factorisation.
recommendations.evidence: slp_chain uses binary keep/reject radius changes; sensitivity computes all die gradients before rejection is known.

metrics: peak temperature at frozen common pin-length caps
pin length at frozen common temperature caps
actual thermal calls, adjoint RHS and complete runtime
proposed_next_comparison.caution: Use exact paired selected layouts; shortlist final candidates for both FV and ATSim. Ranking correlation does not validate absolute temperature or guarantee near-tie ordering.

publication_recheck.note: New run_reference_front CLI method-option pass-through does not change the reviewed optimiser core or diagnostics.
